title: Data Table with Sorting and Pagination
description: Accessible tabular data display with sortable columns, scrollable container for small screens, and pagination for large datasets.

components.reason: Core data table; add USWDS sortable-table JS to enable column sorting. Use table/scrollable.html when there are more than 4 columns
Add when the dataset exceeds ~20 rows
Optional data-source note or 'last updated' callout above the table

nesting: Component 1 is the primary region; wrap it in .usa-table-container--scrollable; component 2 sits directly below component 1; component 3 sits above component 1 when present
validationOrder: Every table has a caption element
All header cells carry scope='col' or scope='row'
Sortable headers expose aria-sort and are focusable buttons
Pagination reflects the current page with aria-current='page'
a11yNotes: Caption is required — describe what the table shows
Sorting controls must be keyboard-operable and announce direction via aria-sort
Keep the scrollable wrapper so wide tables never break page layout on mobile
Provide a text alternative or downloadable data link for complex tables
agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the table tile (order 1); switch to table/scrollable.html if column count is high
2. Add scope attributes to all header cells and a caption
3. Include the USWDS sortable-table initialization if sorting is required
4. Fetch pagination (order 2) only if the dataset is large; place it below the table
5. Optionally add the info summary box above the table
